comparisons.objective: Restore a monitor to a target height slot and tilt.
comparisons.physical_skill: Support the monitor, release a pin, translate it, re-engage the pin, and tilt a hinge.
comparisons.success_condition: Final height and engagement tolerances plus 10-degree tilt over the final 20 controls.
comparisons.reason: Although it sets an angle, it tests load-supported pin indexing and hinge positioning, not screw–locknut countertorque or retained cycling.

comparisons.objective: Copy a reference block assembly on a rotated fixture.
comparisons.physical_skill: Reference-frame reasoning and multi-object placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Each block matches its twin within 8 mm and 10 degrees; further rubric details are absent.
comparisons.reason: Assembly copying has no adjustable mechanism, locking reaction, or functional cycle.

comparisons.objective: Place two tree stakes outside a root ball and across the wind.
comparisons.physical_skill: Geometry-based stake placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Stakes occupy the allowed ring, oppose one another, and align across wind; root-ball contact zeros score.
comparisons.reason: It tests placement geometry rather than mechanical setting retention.

comparisons.objective: Lower a ratchet-held load through an intermediate hold and onto a rest.
comparisons.physical_skill: Carry load through a crank while releasing and re-engaging a pawl.
comparisons.success_condition: Intermediate hands-off hold followed by controlled lowering to the rest; numeric rubric is absent.
comparisons.reason: Load transfer through a ratchet is different from setting a screw stop and locking its calibration.

comparisons.objective: Scoop clean ice from a covered source without contamination.
comparisons.physical_skill: Open a lid, use a scoop, and transfer cubes.
comparisons.success_condition: At least one clean cube delivered by the scoop with required lid history and no contamination.
comparisons.reason: Container access and hygienic transfer do not overlap the candidate’s mechanical ability.

comparisons.objective: Chock both sides of a rolling cradle before removing its load.
comparisons.physical_skill: Place restraints, then extract a load without premature cradle motion.
comparisons.success_condition: Both chocks remain seated throughout relative load motion and the load reaches storage.
comparisons.reason: It tests prerequisite restraint placement and load removal, not calibration locking.

comparisons.objective: Extend an assistive-equipment handle and engage its detent.
comparisons.physical_skill: Withdraw a pin, translate a telescoping member, and positively re-engage the pin.
comparisons.success_condition: Selected extension is locked before release; the available body lacks numeric thresholds.
comparisons.reason: Pin-indexed telescoping adjustment differs from preserving a screw setting during jam-nut tightening and then cycling it.

comparisons.objective: Pack a sensor in a cushioned carton and survive a drop test.
comparisons.physical_skill: Carton selection, insertion, lid tucking, and shock-protective packing.
comparisons.success_condition: Packed sensor remains below 50 g and stable after a 30 cm drop.
comparisons.reason: Protective packaging and impact performance are unrelated to adjustable-stop locking.

comparisons.objective: Cancel and reverse a sample handover after permission withdrawal.
comparisons.physical_skill: Monitor a changing cue, retain the sample, return it, and replace a lid.
comparisons.success_condition: No release after PRIVATE; sample returned and storage closed, with continued-permission controls.
comparisons.reason: It tests online permission compliance rather than mechanical adjustment.

comparisons.objective: Load three boats to depth zones in a tube furnace and cap both ends.
comparisons.physical_skill: Blind rod pushing while counterholding a loose tube, followed by capping.
comparisons.success_condition: Boats reach ordered depth zones and the centered tube is capped; numeric tolerances are absent.
comparisons.reason: Blind insertion-depth control differs from setting and locking an angular stop.

comparisons.objective: Remove a tagged tote while holding back a gravity-fed queue.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual load restraint and tote extraction.
comparisons.success_condition: Tagged tote reaches the bin before queued totes move more than 2 cm, then the queue advances.
comparisons.reason: Shared counterholding is generic; the task has no coupled adjustment, locknut, or retained functional setting.

comparisons.objective: Release a tool from a spring jaw while retaining it and stabilizing a loose fixture.
comparisons.physical_skill: Spring-clamp opening, object retention, and possible counterholding.
comparisons.success_condition: Tool is safely released while the fixture stays controlled; numeric rubric is missing.
comparisons.reason: It tests extraction from a clamp, not calibrated stop adjustment and locking.

comparisons.objective: Pump a chamber to 60 kPa and return the released pump.
comparisons.physical_skill: Counterhold a free barrel while reciprocating a hand pump and reading a gauge.
comparisons.success_condition: Pressure stays within 54–66 kPa and below 80 kPa, with correct final placement and two-second release.
comparisons.reason: Bimanual counterholding is shared only generically; pressure generation and gauge stopping are different abilities.

comparisons.objective: Place a heavy object on a low step and a light box on the other step.
comparisons.physical_skill: Weight-aware object placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Correct one-per-step arrangement; the available body omits numeric placement thresholds.
comparisons.reason: It is a safety-aware sorting task without articulated adjustment or locking.

comparisons.objective: Issue ABO-compatible blood units to three trays.
comparisons.physical_skill: Rule-based selection, inter-arm handover, and placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Compatible units reach each tray and the incompatible AB unit remains stored; numeric placement details are absent.
comparisons.reason: It tests compatibility reasoning and transfer rather than mechanical calibration.

comparisons.objective: Install a missing spacer washer beneath a cap by copying a reference.
comparisons.physical_skill: Stabilize a fixture, remove a cap, perform close-clearance insertion, and recap.
comparisons.success_condition: Washer and cap are correctly installed and both hands released; detailed thresholds are absent.
comparisons.reason: Precision insertion and reassembly do not preserve an adjustable setting against tightening reaction.

comparisons.objective: Remove a scrap sheet while leaving cut parts on a laser bed.
comparisons.physical_skill: Two-hand level lifting of a thin sheet without dragging nested parts.
comparisons.success_condition: Sheet reaches the scrap bin while all cut parts remain on the bed.
comparisons.reason: It tests coordinated sheet lifting, not mechanical stop setting.

comparisons.objective: Load and center a wafer on a spin-coater chuck using dedicated tools.
comparisons.physical_skill: Edge-only tweezer handling, aligner docking, and lid counterholding.
comparisons.success_condition: Wafer centered within 0.5 mm, aligner removed, lid closed, and forbidden contact avoided.
comparisons.reason: Tool-mediated precision placement is different from screw–locknut calibration.

comparisons.objective: Install the correct solar-panel clamp type at each rail position.
comparisons.physical_skill: Clamp-type selection and seating across six locations.
comparisons.success_condition: One sixth per correct, level clamp; the body does not specify fastening or torque thresholds.
comparisons.reason: It tests component selection and placement rather than adjustable-stop locking.

comparisons.objective: Cut a circuit-board lead flush while retaining and disposing of the offcut.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual nipper placement with simultaneous offcut capture.
comparisons.success_condition: Body evidence reports a flush cut and offcut deposited without flying free; exact numeric rubric is absent.
comparisons.reason: Cut-and-capture is clearly unrelated despite the missing full rubric.

comparisons.objective: Fit nail plates only where bored holes violate setback rules.
comparisons.physical_skill: Measure/recognize hole depth and place plates selectively.
comparisons.success_condition: Required studs are plated and all others left unplated; numeric centering details are absent.
comparisons.reason: Rule-based protective plate placement does not overlap mechanical calibration.

comparisons.objective: Unpack a supported optical instrument and collect its foam inserts.
comparisons.physical_skill: Stable bimanual extraction and transfer of a narrow-foot instrument.
comparisons.success_condition: Instrument remains supported, under tilt/descent limits, and released stably; foam goes to the tray.
comparisons.reason: It tests safe load handling rather than setting a mechanism.

comparisons.objective: Adjust an enclosure latch’s threaded grip length and close its wing cam.
comparisons.physical_skill: Threaded adjustment followed by cam closure to establish compression.
comparisons.success_condition: Gap below 1 mm, clamp above 20 N, handle at least 175 degrees, hands-off for 20 seconds.
comparisons.reason: This adjusts compression and closes a cam, but does not require concentric driver/wrench countertorque or preservation of a stop through repeated articulation.

comparisons.objective: Lock a floating guide rod at the carriage-defined end position and prove full travel.
comparisons.physical_skill: Use carriage position to establish a rod location, lock it, then operate a crank.
comparisons.success_condition: Carriage runs the slide’s full length and back without sticking after release; numeric rubric is missing.
comparisons.reason: It validates guide alignment set by a carriage, whereas the candidate specifically tests resisting jam-nut reaction while preserving an angular screw stop.

comparisons.objective: Reseat a loose AED pad, clear the patient, and deliver a training shock.
comparisons.physical_skill: Pad pressing, withdrawal, and remote button operation.
comparisons.success_condition: Pad attached and both grippers at least 15 cm clear from shock through one second afterward.
comparisons.reason: It tests medical safety clearance rather than mechanical adjustment.

comparisons.objective: Select the proper tool and hand it over handle-first.
comparisons.physical_skill: Tool identification, extraction from a pile, orientation, and safe handover.
comparisons.success_condition: Mallet handle rests correctly in the coworker’s palm and other tools remain undisturbed.
comparisons.reason: Tool selection and handover are unrelated to using tools on a coupled adjustment.

comparisons.objective: Raise a loaded stand by two pin holes.
comparisons.physical_skill: Transfer load while releasing and reseating two pull pins under unequal assistance.
comparisons.success_condition: Stand is level, pins reseated, released for one second, and jolt/speed/force limits respected.
comparisons.reason: It is load-bearing dual-pin height adjustment, not torque-preserving screw-stop calibration.

comparisons.objective: Search boxes once each, retrieve buttons, and reclose them.
comparisons.physical_skill: Hold boxes while sliding lids, track search history, and transfer a small container.
comparisons.success_condition: Buttons reach the sewing tray, boxes are properly closed, and search/order constraints hold; numeric rubric is absent.
comparisons.reason: It tests constrained search and drawer-like manipulation.

comparisons.objective: Roll a steel drum into an angled bay.
comparisons.physical_skill: Apply coordinated opposite-end forces to steer a rolling cylinder.
comparisons.success_condition: Drum reaches the bay against the back bar, is released for one second, and sliding earns at most 0.75.
comparisons.reason: Dynamic rolling control does not overlap adjustable-stop locking.

comparisons.objective: Extract a robot-assembly spacer using a pusher.
comparisons.physical_skill: Tool-assisted constrained extraction with contact management.
comparisons.success_condition: Spacer is extracted and released safely; the available body defers detailed thresholds to an unavailable README.
comparisons.reason: It tests removal of a fitted component, not adjustment and retention of a motion stop.

comparisons.objective: Read a pressure gauge and refuse opening a pressurized filter housing.
comparisons.physical_skill: Instrument inspection and call-button operation without hazardous disassembly.
comparisons.success_condition: Cover stays shut, cartridge stays in place, and a call button is pressed; numeric rubric is absent.
comparisons.reason: It tests hazard recognition and refusal, not mechanical manipulation calibration.

comparisons.objective: Stop a grinder and wait for rundown before retrieving a part.
comparisons.physical_skill: Button operation, temporal monitoring, and delayed pickup.
comparisons.success_condition: Part reaches the tray only after the wheel fully stops; detailed partial thresholds are absent.
comparisons.reason: Safe sequencing around rotating equipment differs from locking a stop.

comparisons.objective: Place each sandbag on the stand leg beneath its boom.
comparisons.physical_skill: Infer support geometry and orient/place flexible-load stand-ins.
comparisons.success_condition: Each bag lies lengthwise 7–13 cm from its post on the correct leg; a wrong leg zeros score.
comparisons.reason: It is geometry-based ballast placement without an adjustable mechanism.

comparisons.objective: Set a drill-press depth stop and prove the resulting depth twice.
comparisons.physical_skill: One arm holds a catch open while the other adjusts a motion stop, followed by repeated downfeed testing.
comparisons.success_condition: Two loaded strokes stop at the target depth and return repeatably after release.
comparisons.reason: Both tasks test bimanual adjustment of a mechanical travel stop followed by repeated functional verification; the candidate’s jam nut and angular geometry add mechanism detail but not a clearly different overall tested ability.

comparisons.objective: Depressurize and verify zero pressure before opening a filter cover.
comparisons.physical_skill: Valve operation, status verification, cover opening, and cartridge removal.
comparisons.success_condition: Inlet closed, pressure indication off before opening, and cartridge binned; numeric thresholds are absent.
comparisons.reason: It tests safe energy isolation and disassembly.

comparisons.objective: Clear an occupied knife-holder path before inserting a knife.
comparisons.physical_skill: Remove an obstruction and perform safe slot insertion.
comparisons.success_condition: Knife inserted and toy safely released outside the holder; invalid insertion-path handling loses credit.
comparisons.reason: Obstruction clearing and insertion do not overlap stop calibration.

comparisons.objective: Remove a knife hazard before opening a lift valve three turns.
comparisons.physical_skill: Hazard removal followed by handwheel rotation.
comparisons.success_condition: Knife moved safely before valve actuation; opening with the knife present scores zero.
comparisons.reason: Valve turning is not used to set and lock a retained motion limit.

comparisons.objective: Damp a swinging load by timed trolley motion.
comparisons.physical_skill: Closed-loop dynamic sway cancellation without touching the load.
comparisons.success_condition: Trolley reaches its mark and released load stays within 1.5 degrees of vertical for one second.
comparisons.reason: Dynamic oscillation control is materially different from quasi-static adjustment and locking.

comparisons.objective: Hang a cabinet level on a French cleat.
comparisons.physical_skill: Two-hand level lifting, alignment, wedging, and release.
comparisons.success_condition: Cabinet cleat is fully engaged, cabinet level and released; tipping permanently zeros score.
comparisons.reason: It tests large-object alignment and support engagement.

comparisons.objective: Support an optical bar before withdrawing its carriage.
comparisons.physical_skill: Continuous bimanual load transfer and support removal.
comparisons.success_condition: Actual relative clearance is achieved while the bar remains supported; detailed numeric rubric is absent.
comparisons.reason: Load-support transfer differs from preserving a calibrated screw setting.

comparisons.objective: Remove and stow all remove-before-flight items.
comparisons.physical_skill: Recognize and extract three different restraints, then place them in a bag.
comparisons.success_condition: One third per item stowed; removed items left loose earn nothing.
comparisons.reason: It tests multi-part removal and foreign-object control.

comparisons.objective: Build an ordered chain of eccentrically weighted bars on a narrow pedestal.
comparisons.physical_skill: Sequential balancing under changing interface loads.
comparisons.success_condition: Valid ordered prefixes earn partial credit and the final chain stands released for 20 seconds.
comparisons.reason: Balancing and stacking are unrelated to mechanical stop locking.

comparisons.objective: Lower a fragile cabinet by metering a hydraulic release valve.
comparisons.physical_skill: Continuous valve force control and controlled landing under load.
comparisons.success_condition: Cabinet lands gently on rails without glass contact and remains hands-off for three seconds.
comparisons.reason: It tests velocity regulation of a load, not angular calibration retention.

comparisons.objective: Pass a drill to a coworker handle-first while holding its body.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual tool carrying, orientation, and careful handover.
comparisons.success_condition: Handle rests in the palm, chuck points away, and the drill is released without bumping the hand.
comparisons.reason: Safe handover is different from operating tools on an adjustment mechanism.

comparisons.objective: Store keys in the initially open drawer, close it, then later retrieve them from only that drawer.
comparisons.physical_skill: Chest counterholding, drawer manipulation, memory, and object transfer.
comparisons.success_condition: Keys follow the prescribed storage/retrieval locations without opening another drawer; numeric rubric is absent.
comparisons.reason: It tests memory-guided drawer manipulation.

comparisons.objective: Orient a telescope mount north using a compass removed from magnetic interference.
comparisons.physical_skill: Move and read a compass, then rotate a large fixture.
comparisons.success_condition: Available evidence states the intended orientation but gives no numeric tolerance or complete rubric.
comparisons.reason: Compass-based orientation is unrelated to locking and cycling a mechanical stop.

comparisons.objective: Hold a wafer and remove surrogate debris with a blow gun.
comparisons.physical_skill: Two-tool coordination, edge-safe wafer holding, and sweeping.
comparisons.success_condition: All particles removed and wafer and gun returned; detailed thresholds are absent.
comparisons.reason: Cleaning and fragile-part handling do not overlap mechanical adjustment.

comparisons.objective: Select, mount, lock, and set an inverted zoom lens to 50 mm.
comparisons.physical_skill: Lens selection, bayonet mounting, locking, and friction-sensitive ring adjustment.
comparisons.success_condition: Compatible lens remains mounted and retains 50 mm after release; numeric tolerance is absent in this record.
comparisons.reason: It tests component selection and passive zoom-ring retention, not preservation of a screw stop during locknut tightening and repeated mechanism cycles.

comparisons.objective: Open a sliding cabinet after removing a key obstructing its track.
comparisons.physical_skill: Diagnose and clear a track obstruction, then slide a guided pane.
comparisons.success_condition: Door opens at least the demonstrated distance without losing the key or violating the guide.
comparisons.reason: Obstruction removal and sliding-door operation differ from mechanical calibration.

comparisons.objective: Orient an angle-grinder guard toward the operator and clamp it.
comparisons.physical_skill: Rotate a guard to a safe orientation and actuate its clamp; detailed mechanism is absent.
comparisons.success_condition: Body evidence reports a 1.0 demo but omits the numeric scoring and retention thresholds.
comparisons.reason: Although both set an angle and lock it, this record tests guard orientation and clamping, not concentric screw/jam-nut countertorque followed by repeated articulated cycles.

comparisons.objective: Handle a wafer with a passive pick and remove debris using a blow gun.
comparisons.physical_skill: Control a spring-closed pick while coordinating a second tool.
comparisons.success_condition: Debris removed, objects returned, and drops, face contact, or robot collisions avoided.
comparisons.reason: Its coupled tool handling serves cleaning, not adjustable-stop locking.

comparisons.objective: Secure a gas cylinder upright in a bench clamp.
comparisons.physical_skill: Large-object alignment, upright support, and clamp closure.
comparisons.success_condition: Cylinder is secured upright and released; numeric thresholds are absent.
comparisons.reason: Clamping a workpiece does not calibrate or verify a motion stop.

comparisons.objective: Close a tool-chest lid while holding its stay release.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual release holding and controlled lid lowering.
comparisons.success_condition: Lid rests flat on its rim and is released; detailed damage/force thresholds are absent.
comparisons.reason: It tests coordinated closure of a supported lid.

comparisons.objective: Fold a ten-leaf wooden rule into its storage recess.
comparisons.physical_skill: Multi-hinge folding, regrasping overlapping leaves, and placement.
comparisons.success_condition: All leaves compactly fit the recess, are supported, clear of the robot, and stable for one second.
comparisons.reason: Multi-articulation folding and stowage differ from stop calibration.

comparisons.objective: Clip a spring-gate carabiner onto a steel staple.
comparisons.physical_skill: Use the staple to open the gate, pass it into the loop, and release after closure.
comparisons.success_condition: Staple is enclosed, gate closed, carabiner supported, hands clear, and stable for one second.
comparisons.reason: Spring-gate insertion and linkage do not overlap adjustable-stop locking.

comparisons.objective: Remove and store transport keys before unloading a captive carrier.
comparisons.physical_skill: Extract retained pins and obey a physically enforced prerequisite before carrier motion.
comparisons.success_condition: Both keys are stored before supported carrier unloading; numeric final tolerances are absent.
comparisons.reason: It tests restraint removal and prerequisite sequencing.

comparisons.objective: Extract a load-bearing bracket pin while maintaining carriage height.
comparisons.physical_skill: Support a weighted carriage while pulling a retaining pin.
comparisons.success_condition: Pin extracted without unsafe load drop; detailed thresholds are absent in the available body.
comparisons.reason: Fastener extraction under load differs from adjusting and locking a calibrated stop.

comparisons.objective: Lift a crate only after two fork bars are fully engaged.
comparisons.physical_skill: Align dual supports, insert them under a load, and lift level.
comparisons.success_condition: The available record gives no rubric beyond full engagement and level lifting.
comparisons.reason: Fork engagement and balanced lifting do not overlap mechanical calibration.

comparisons.objective: Quench two aluminium fittings before a deadline while cooling a steel fitting separately.
comparisons.physical_skill: Fast parallel bimanual sorting and transfer.
comparisons.success_condition: Both aluminium parts submerged within six seconds, steel kept out of water and placed on its rack.
comparisons.reason: Timed material handling is unrelated to adjustable-stop locking.

comparisons.objective: Shelve artifacts so shorter objects are not hidden behind taller ones.
comparisons.physical_skill: Multi-object depth ordering and placement in a narrow shelf.
comparisons.success_condition: Objects are shelved without hidden or crowded arrangements; each object can earn partial credit.
comparisons.reason: It tests spatial organization rather than mechanism adjustment.

comparisons.objective: Remove a file and leave an out-card in its exact shelf position.
comparisons.physical_skill: Packed-row extraction, inter-arm division, and narrow-gap insertion.
comparisons.success_condition: Out-card stands in the gap, file reaches its stand, and neighboring files remain unmoved.
comparisons.reason: It is a constrained replacement-marker task, not calibration.

comparisons.objective: Test phone power buttons and sort phones by response.
comparisons.physical_skill: Three-second button holds, outcome observation, and sorting.
comparisons.success_condition: Working phones go to green and nonworking phones to grey after testing.
comparisons.reason: Functional diagnosis and sorting differ from locking a mechanical setting.

comparisons.objective: Join a cemented PVC pipe to a tee with a quarter turn and sustained hold.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual insertion, rotation, counterholding, and sustained compression.
comparisons.success_condition: Assembly occurs within 15 seconds and is held together for 30 seconds without push-out.
comparisons.reason: Shared counterholding is generic; this is irreversible socket insertion rather than adjustable-stop calibration and locknut retention.

comparisons.objective: Hoist a bucket through a gin wheel and land it on a scaffold deck.
comparisons.physical_skill: Rope hauling, suspended-load guidance, and controlled payout.
comparisons.success_condition: Bucket lands on the deck without prohibited carrying or hands under the load; detailed thresholds are absent.
comparisons.reason: Rope and suspended-load control are materially different.

comparisons.objective: Open only the junction box containing a caught cable, free it, reclose the box, and extract the cable.
comparisons.physical_skill: Fault localization, lid manipulation, and cable extraction.
comparisons.success_condition: Cable reaches the tray after only the correct box is opened and reclosed; numeric rubric is absent.
comparisons.reason: It tests diagnosis and cable handling, not mechanical setting retention.

comparisons.objective: Track a moving figure with a camera and react to a stop cue.
comparisons.physical_skill: Closed-loop pan-bar control plus time-critical second-arm button operation.
comparisons.success_condition: Camera remains aimed at the figure and the cue button is pressed within one second; numeric aim tolerance is missing.
comparisons.reason: Dynamic visual tracking and reaction are unrelated to stop calibration.

comparisons.objective: Push a hose onto a valve barb, position a clamp, and proof-lift the assembly.
comparisons.physical_skill: Counterhold a valve, force-fit a hose, slide a clamp, and conduct a lift check.
comparisons.success_condition: Hose overlaps the barb by at least 2 cm, clamp covers it, and the released assembly passes a lift demonstration.
comparisons.reason: It tests interference-fit assembly and clamp placement, not setting an adjustable stop against locknut torque.

comparisons.objective: Post a wet-floor sign before wiping a spill.
comparisons.physical_skill: Deploy a sign, then wipe a mapped surface with a sponge.
comparisons.success_condition: Sign stands 6–20 cm from the spill before sponge contact; wiping coverage yields partial credit.
comparisons.reason: Safety sequencing and wiping do not overlap the candidate’s mechanism.

comparisons.objective: Test a water-heater relief valve and report whether it is blocked.
comparisons.physical_skill: Quarter-turn a knob, observe travel, and place a report tag.
comparisons.success_condition: Credit for at least 15-degree knob motion and correct condition reporting.
comparisons.reason: It diagnoses valve travel but does not adjust, lock, or preserve a calibrated motion limit.

comparisons.objective: Proof-pull an anchor plate to a target load while stabilizing it.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual counterholding and force-band regulation.
comparisons.success_condition: Gauge carriage reaches and holds the proof-load band for one second, then eases back.
comparisons.reason: Counterholding is generic; force testing does not set and lock a stop.

comparisons.objective: Choose a friction liner that keeps a glass stable on an incline.
comparisons.physical_skill: Material selection, liner placement, and stable glass placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Glass remains released and unbraced on the lined 20-degree rack for up to 20 seconds.
comparisons.reason: It tests friction selection and stability.

comparisons.objective: Press randomly illuminated buttons before their one-second windows expire.
comparisons.physical_skill: Visual reaction and rapid target-directed pressing.
comparisons.success_condition: Five valid physical presses within 120 seconds; otherwise binary zero.
comparisons.reason: Reaction-time button operation is unrelated to mechanical adjustment.

comparisons.objective: Route concealed conduit only through permitted horizontal/vertical wall zones.
comparisons.physical_skill: Select lengths and construct a compliant L-shaped route.
comparisons.success_condition: Both boxes connected through safe zones, with no diagonal or spare conduit left out of zone.
comparisons.reason: It tests spatial routing rules rather than mechanism calibration.

comparisons.objective: Mount and lock an inverted zoom lens, set it to 50 mm, and verify passive retention.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bayonet alignment, pin locking, zoom-ring adjustment, and inverted retention handling.
comparisons.success_condition: Lens remains locked and at 48–52 mm for 20 seconds after release.
comparisons.reason: Although both preserve a setting, this tests selection/mounting and passive ring friction rather than two-tool jam-nut countertorque plus repeated mechanism cycling.

comparisons.objective: Hand off and insert a duplex fibre connector into a keyed adapter.
comparisons.physical_skill: Inter-arm transfer, cable retention, and sub-millimetre coupled peg insertion.
comparisons.success_condition: Connector remains inserted, released, and stable for 20 seconds.
comparisons.reason: Precision cable-bound insertion is different from adjustable-stop locking.

comparisons.objective: Inflate a tyre to 1.5 bar with a gauge-less hand pump.
comparisons.physical_skill: Hold a push-on head throughout repeated pumping and count strokes.
comparisons.success_condition: Tyre reaches target pressure without a visible gauge; the available record omits tolerance and failure thresholds.
comparisons.reason: Bimanual pumping and action counting do not overlap stop calibration.

comparisons.objective: Place an unscrewed reagent cap inside-up without contaminating its interior.
comparisons.physical_skill: Delicate reorientation and contact-avoiding placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Cap released on its rest with no interior or opening-rim contact; forbidden contact is persistently latched.
comparisons.reason: It tests protected-surface handling, not mechanical adjustment.

comparisons.objective: Develop an exposed wafer through timed immersion.
comparisons.physical_skill: Wafer handling and countdown-controlled immersion.
comparisons.success_condition: Full immersion lasts 28–32 seconds; other detailed rubric conditions are not in the body.
comparisons.reason: Timed chemical-process handling differs from mechanical calibration.

comparisons.objective: Seat a strain-wave flexspline in a robot-joint housing until its teeth mesh.
comparisons.physical_skill: Coaxial insertion with rotation to achieve tooth engagement.
comparisons.success_condition: Collar sits flat, teeth mesh, and the unit is released; numeric tolerances are absent.
comparisons.reason: Robot assembly relevance is shared, but tooth-meshing insertion is a different tested ability from stop adjustment and locking.

comparisons.objective: Identify opaque bottles by weight and recycle only the empty ones.
comparisons.physical_skill: Active lifting for weight discrimination and sorting.
comparisons.success_condition: Each empty bottle upright in the bin earns 0.5; any full bottle binned or bottle tipped zeros score.
comparisons.reason: It tests haptic classification and sorting.

comparisons.objective: Find a hidden balance point and hang a weighted tube level on one hook.
comparisons.physical_skill: Exploratory test lifts, balance estimation, and long-object hanging.
comparisons.success_condition: Tube hangs within 3 degrees, released and still for two seconds without being dropped.
comparisons.reason: It tests active mass-property estimation rather than mechanism calibration.

comparisons.objective: Set two sprinkler trip collars to define a 90-degree arc.
comparisons.physical_skill: Rotate two collar components to a specified relative angle.
comparisons.success_condition: Blue pin is 90 degrees counter-clockwise from red and released; the record lacks tolerances and functional-cycle checks.
comparisons.reason: It shares angular setting only; it does not establish concentric screw–jam-nut locking, countertorque, or retained actuation.

comparisons.objective: Sort glasses and plates into dedicated bussing containers with plates ordered by size.
comparisons.physical_skill: Repeated inter-arm handoffs, upright glass placement, and ordered stacking.

comparisons.reason: This duplicates PR-278 internally, but remains distinct from the candidate’s threaded calibration and locking ability.

comparisons.objective: Shelve three books upright and brace the row with a bookend.
comparisons.physical_skill: Repeated upright insertion, gap control, and terminal bracing.
comparisons.success_condition: Books form a closed upright row with gaps at most 5 mm and tilt at most 5 degrees; flat or stacked books zero the trial.
comparisons.reason: Shelving and bracing do not test coupled screw-and-locknut manipulation.

comparisons.objective: Stabilize a leaning panel with a physical stopper and survive a pull test.
comparisons.physical_skill: Supporting an unstable load while positioning a passive brace.
comparisons.success_condition: Stopper seated, hands withdrawn, panel survives a 0.6 N pull and 2-second stability check within displacement and tilt limits.
comparisons.reason: Passive structural bracing differs from adjustment-thread counterholding and retained articulated motion.

comparisons.objective: Run a press cycle using both safety buttons, then remove the part.
comparisons.physical_skill: Sustained simultaneous button actuation followed by guarded retrieval.
comparisons.success_condition: Both buttons held throughout the closing stroke, hands kept out of the die, then part transferred after the safe indication.
comparisons.reason: Two-hand safety control tests occupancy and timing, not precision mechanical adjustment.

comparisons.objective: Return a medium box to its ordered position in a shelf size run.
comparisons.physical_skill: Shifting neighboring stock, cross-arm handoff, and row closure.
comparisons.success_condition: Medium box lies between small and large boxes with the row closed against end and back stops; numeric tiers are absent.
comparisons.reason: Ordered stock insertion does not involve threaded locking or functional verification.

comparisons.objective: Remove, clear, and reinstall a rocking deck board.
comparisons.physical_skill: Using the board as a lever, coordinated lifting, debris removal, and close-fit reinsertion.
comparisons.success_condition: Pebble in the bucket earns partial credit; full credit requires the board reinstalled flush.
comparisons.reason: Lever-assisted extraction and reinsertion differ from concentric countertorque on adjustment hardware.

comparisons.objective: Clear boxes from a marked emergency-exit walkway.
comparisons.physical_skill: Repeated object relocation with loss avoidance.
comparisons.success_condition: Full score for no blocking boxes and none lost; one blocker earns 0.5; loss or multiple blockers scores zero.
comparisons.reason: Area clearing is ordinary transfer, not mechanical calibration.

comparisons.objective: Pack groceries so raw chicken is not above ready-to-eat food.
comparisons.physical_skill: Hazard-aware selection, placement, and stacking.
comparisons.success_condition: Safe packing with raw meat below ready-to-eat food; numeric geometry and partial-credit details are absent.
comparisons.reason: Packing-order safety has no adjustment or locking mechanism in common.

comparisons.objective: Latch a toolbox before carrying it by the lid handle to a shelf.
comparisons.physical_skill: Sequential latch closure and safe load transfer.
comparisons.success_condition: Progress from one latch to both, then lifted and shelved; spills, excessive tip, fall, drop, or airborne lid opening score zero.
comparisons.reason: Closing discrete latches before transport does not preserve a continuous screw setting under locknut torque.

comparisons.objective: Move vials only while a permit indicator is green.
comparisons.physical_skill: Repeated transfers synchronized to an intermittent authorization state.
comparisons.success_condition: Four vials loaded, each lift begun under green, and placement completed within 3 seconds of a lapse.
comparisons.reason: Permit-timed transfer does not test threaded mechanical adjustment.

comparisons.objective: Arrange candles at type-dependent safety distances from each other and hazards.
comparisons.physical_skill: Rule-guided spatial placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Three candles meet 3/7 cm pair spacing, 30 cm flammable clearance, and 50 cm overhead clearance.
comparisons.reason: Geometric safety placement is unrelated to stop calibration and jam-nut locking.

comparisons.objective: Hold a pipe and tighten its plastic union nut until snug without stripping it.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization and torque-limited nut tightening.
comparisons.success_condition: Union nut snug against its collar, pipe stable, both hands released, and no overtightening; numeric torque thresholds are absent.
comparisons.reason: This is the closest threaded neighbor, but it tightens a union to a terminal seat rather than counterholding an adjustable screw while locking a retained setting and proving it over repeated motion.

comparisons.objective: Hold an acrylic sheet while peeling its protective film by a tab.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual compliant peeling with substrate restraint.
comparisons.success_condition: Film fully removed via the tab and deposited in the basket without lifting the sheet or tearing the tab.
comparisons.reason: Peeling a deformable layer under restraint is not threaded calibration.

comparisons.objective: Select fine tweezers, peel display film through a narrow slot, and return tools.
comparisons.physical_skill: Tool selection, narrow-slot tab grasping, peeling, carrier restraint, and tool return.
comparisons.success_condition: All 115 mm peeled in 5 mm increments, carrier controlled, film laid aside, and both tools returned.
comparisons.reason: Fine-tool peeling and carrier restraint differ from screw/nut countertorque and cyclic retention.

comparisons.objective: Respond to a gas warning by latching the mechanical shutoff instead of igniting a stove.
comparisons.physical_skill: Hazard recognition and control actuation.
comparisons.success_condition: Shutoff latched with knobs off earns full score; knob turns earn 0.2 and ignition permanently caps the score.
comparisons.reason: Emergency shutoff selection is not an adjustable-stop locking task.

comparisons.objective: Remove metal fragments without touching or displacing a nearby artery.
comparisons.physical_skill: Fine extraction with obstacle avoidance.
comparisons.success_condition: Weighted credit per fragment; artery touches halve score, while repeated touch or displacement zeros it.
comparisons.reason: Microscale extraction and avoidance do not involve threaded adjustment.

comparisons.objective: Tilt a chassis so a dropped screw slides out, then retrieve it magnetically.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual chassis holding, gravity-assisted recovery, and magnetic tool use.
comparisons.success_condition: Screw reaches the parts dish, tool is returned, chassis reset, and arms withdrawn; numeric tiers are absent.
comparisons.reason: Recovering loose hardware does not set or lock a screw-controlled mechanism.

comparisons.objective: Index a Geneva drive twice and prove its dwell.
comparisons.physical_skill: Driving a contact-mediated intermittent mechanism through engagement and dwell.
comparisons.success_condition: Two valid indexing cycles followed by stable dwell and both hands released.
comparisons.reason: Both verify articulated behavior, but Geneva indexing tests roller-slot transmission rather than preserving a calibrated stop through jam-nut countertorque.

comparisons.objective: Relocate a bar without dropping a loose reflector ball resting on it.
comparisons.physical_skill: Dynamic load balancing during object transport.
comparisons.success_condition: Bar on the target pad with ball retained; any ball-table or ball-pad contact fails.
comparisons.reason: Balance-preserving transport is unrelated to mechanical adjustment locking.

comparisons.objective: Warm a baby bottle safely using a water bath rather than a microwave.
comparisons.physical_skill: Method selection and upright supported placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Bottle safely lifted, placed upright with neck above water, released and stable; microwave activation or submersion zeros score.
comparisons.reason: Safe-method selection and placement do not test threaded calibration.

comparisons.objective: Ballast two portable goals on their rear ground bars.
comparisons.physical_skill: Inferring tip direction and placing sandbags on opposite-facing structures.
comparisons.success_condition: Each goal with a bag on its rear bar earns 0.5; bags on the ground earn nothing.
comparisons.reason: Ballast placement shares no specific mechanism with adjustment screw locking.

comparisons.objective: Transfer two fruits to bowls despite a visibly missing left gripper.
comparisons.physical_skill: Adapting ordinary pick-and-place to embodiment damage.
comparisons.success_condition: Orange and apple delivered to their corresponding bowls; each transfer contributes half.
comparisons.reason: Embodiment adaptation for transfer does not exercise countertorque or retained settings.

comparisons.objective: Arrange page blocks into an eight-page saddle-stitch imposition.
comparisons.physical_skill: Rule-based planar sorting and placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Correct page pairs, sheet membership, and even-page side earn face-level partial credit; reading order scores zero.
comparisons.reason: Page imposition is chiefly layout reasoning, not mechanical manipulation of an adjustable stop.

comparisons.objective: Recover a sample carrier from under a retaining lip without tipping its samples.
comparisons.physical_skill: Coordinated two-arm shared-load extraction and leveling.
comparisons.success_condition: Carrier reaches its stand with four samples retained and acceptable tilt; one-sided toppling scores zero.
comparisons.reason: Shared-load extraction differs from concentric tools applying opposing torques.

comparisons.objective: Break an over-center strut at its knee and fold a radiator panel onto rests.
comparisons.physical_skill: Unlocking a load-bearing linkage and controlling articulated descent.
comparisons.success_condition: Panel folded onto black rest pads and released; no numeric rubric is indexed.
comparisons.reason: Over-center linkage release and stowage do not preserve an adjustable stop setting.

comparisons.objective: Rotate an open shell 90 degrees around a held shaft while both are airborne.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual relative-pose control around an axis.
comparisons.success_condition: Measured 90-degree shell-to-shaft relation with both bodies clear of the table; detailed tolerances are absent.
comparisons.reason: Relative in-air clocking lacks threaded adjustment, locking, and post-lock functional cycles.

comparisons.objective: Start a hex nut on a stud without cross-threading and run it down by hand.
comparisons.physical_skill: Thread engagement using reverse-turn drop detection followed by forward threading.
comparisons.success_condition: Title specifies correct thread start and run-down; the indexed record has no numeric scoring rubric.
comparisons.reason: Thread-start quality is different from counterholding an already engaged adjustment screw while tightening its jam nut and preserving calibration.

comparisons.objective: Meter a hydraulic valve to lower a fragile cabinet gently onto rails.
comparisons.physical_skill: Continuous valve force control under load and gentle landing.
comparisons.success_condition: Safe landing speed, no glass contact, load transferred to rails, and a released 3-second hold.
comparisons.reason: Load-dependent hydraulic metering does not test screw-and-locknut calibration.

comparisons.objective: Take a curling shot while intercepting a runaway stone.
comparisons.physical_skill: Coordinated dynamic sliding and timed interception.
comparisons.success_condition: Target shot completed, runaway saved, arms withdrawn, all stones retained, and no unauthorized contacts.
comparisons.reason: Dynamic interception and game-piece control are unrelated to threaded mechanism setup.

comparisons.objective: Start a pendulum and stop it on its third swing while holding its stand.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization, timing, counting, and button actuation.
comparisons.success_condition: Bob released from 20 degrees, brake pressed once on the third right return, pendulum stopped vertically, then released.
comparisons.reason: Timed pendulum control does not involve calibration locking.

comparisons.objective: Set two locking paper-cassette guides snug against an A4 stack.
comparisons.physical_skill: Squeeze-to-release sliding adjustment and independent relocking.
comparisons.success_condition: Both guides snug to the stack, stack unmoved, guide tabs released and locked; numeric snug tolerances are absent.
comparisons.reason: Although both adjust and lock, cassette guides use independent squeeze locks and contact-to-stack positioning, not concentric screw/jam-nut countertorque or repeated articulation verification.

comparisons.objective: Operate a spring-return coffee shelf and return a filled mug safely.
comparisons.physical_skill: Shelf actuation, vessel handling, and quasi-static spill avoidance.
comparisons.success_condition: Mug returned to its saucer with 120 ml retained, zero spill or safety faults, and all task stages complete.
comparisons.reason: Liquid-serving manipulation does not test an adjustable stop mechanism.

comparisons.objective: Discover the reverse direction of a key lock, unlock it, and slide a lid open.
comparisons.physical_skill: Torque-sensitive turning while stabilizing a loose box, followed by lid translation.
comparisons.success_condition: Clockwise key progress and lid opening earn tiers; pin shear, prying, excessive tilt, or fall zeros score.
comparisons.reason: Both use bimanual rotational restraint, but the lock task discovers a direction and opens a box rather than preserving a calibrated screw position during jam-nut tightening.

comparisons.objective: Probe three test points in order with a tethered probe.
comparisons.physical_skill: Fine tool-tip placement and tether management.
comparisons.success_condition: Pads 1–3 touched in order for at least 1 second each, lead kept off components, then probe returned and released.
comparisons.reason: Ordered electrical probing is not mechanical adjustment or locking.

comparisons.objective: Remove an internal obstruction, then fully screw a jar lid on.
comparisons.physical_skill: Unscrewing, emptying, rethreading, and torque-limited closure.
comparisons.success_condition: Lid removed, block extracted, lid rethreaded and seated; forcing, tipping, or skipping removal scores zero.
comparisons.reason: Jar rethreading and terminal closure do not retain a continuous adjustment against a separate jam nut.

comparisons.objective: Close a gas valve and pin its handle in the locked-out position.
comparisons.physical_skill: Quarter-turn valve operation followed by aligned pin insertion.
comparisons.success_condition: Valve against its closed stop and lockout pin seated through both aligned holes; detailed tiers are absent.
comparisons.reason: Discrete valve lockout uses pin alignment, not screw/nut countertorque or calibrated retained motion.

comparisons.objective: Test two recessed spring plungers using a pin tool.
comparisons.physical_skill: Recessed axial tool insertion, pressing, dwell, and release verification.
comparisons.success_condition: Each plunger depressed at least 8 mm, briefly held, allowed to return, and tool returned with grippers open.
comparisons.reason: Spring-plunger testing verifies return but has no adjustment-setting or locknut operation.

comparisons.objective: Separate nested trays and place both upright in assigned bays.
comparisons.physical_skill: Rigid-body denesting and controlled placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Released stable separation earns 0.5; correct bay placement held 2 seconds earns 1.0.
comparisons.reason: Denesting and placement share no specific threaded calibration ability.

comparisons.objective: Place only dog-safe snacks in a dog bowl.
comparisons.physical_skill: Semantic hazard classification and pick-and-place.
comparisons.success_condition: Safe foods delivered while chocolate and raisins are excluded; numeric geometry is not indexed.
comparisons.reason: Food selection is unrelated to mechanical stop adjustment.

comparisons.objective: Settle a blackjack by paying a 3:2 win and collecting a busted bet.
comparisons.physical_skill: Chip counting, stacking, cross-arm handoff, and rule-compliant placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Correct three-chip payout beside the bet, busted wager racked, original bet untouched; capping or breaking it scores zero.
comparisons.reason: Chip accounting and placement do not test adjustment hardware.

comparisons.objective: Hold a block upright while closing a vise jaw around it.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual part support and clamp closure.
comparisons.success_condition: Block clamped with its top 25–45 mm above the jaws, then both hands released; further thresholds are absent.
comparisons.reason: Vise clamping secures a workpiece and does not preserve a screw-set calibration through jam-nut countertorque.

comparisons.objective: Hang a slotted holder on two keyhole studs.
comparisons.physical_skill: Simultaneous millimeter-scale alignment, insertion over heads, and gravity seating.
comparisons.success_condition: Both stud heads passed, shanks bearing at slot ends, holder released and still for 1 second.
comparisons.reason: Dual-feature hanging is an insertion task, not threaded adjustment and cyclic verification.

comparisons.objective: Insert multimeter leads into the correct COM and V/ohm jacks.
comparisons.physical_skill: Color/label selection and close-clearance banana-plug insertion.
comparisons.success_condition: Black lead in COM and red lead in V/ohm, excluding the 10 A jack; numeric seating rubric is absent.
comparisons.reason: Connector selection and insertion do not test mechanical locking.

comparisons.objective: Denest and distribute six traffic cones evenly along a curved path.
comparisons.physical_skill: Repeated denesting, transport, upright placement, and spacing control.
comparisons.success_condition: All cones upright, supported, released, within 2 cm of the curve, with adjacent-gap deviation at most 5 cm.
comparisons.reason: Cone distribution is unrelated to threaded calibration.

comparisons.objective: Inspect covered cases and return an instrument to the empty one.
comparisons.physical_skill: Repeated lid manipulation, visual inspection, module transfer, and reseating.
comparisons.success_condition: Module placed only in the empty case; entering an occupied case permanently zeros score.
comparisons.reason: Covered-case selection and transfer do not involve adjustment locking.

comparisons.objective: Register a blank against fixture stops and secure it with an eccentric cam.
comparisons.physical_skill: Part loading and passive cam clamping.
comparisons.success_condition: Correctly registered blank retained after release; the body reports a full-score demo but omits numeric rubric details.
comparisons.reason: This replacement for PR-180 still clamps a separate blank rather than counterholding and locking an adjustable screw setting.

comparisons.objective: Knock down pegs through a narrow port without loading its edges.
comparisons.physical_skill: Tool insertion and pivoting about a constrained opening.
comparisons.success_condition: Three pegs displaced while loose port posts remain acceptably undisturbed; numeric post limits are absent.
comparisons.reason: Remote rod pivoting and edge avoidance do not test threaded locking.

comparisons.objective: Free a target panel from a leaning rack while moving only necessary panels.
comparisons.physical_skill: Sequential support-preserving panel extraction and upright placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Target on inspection plate, moved blockers upright on the mat, no panel beyond 10 degrees, and unnecessary panels untouched.
comparisons.reason: Keystone-style load management is unrelated to calibrated screw adjustment.

comparisons.objective: Manipulate a faucet to diagnose its hidden fault and file the matching report.
comparisons.physical_skill: Active mechanical testing followed by diagnosis tagging.
comparisons.success_condition: Correct tag for normal, will-not-open, or will-not-shut mode; wrong diagnosis receives 0.3.
comparisons.reason: Although it verifies mechanism behavior, it diagnoses discrete faults rather than adjusting and locking a stop.

comparisons.objective: Site a rain gauge and orient an instrument screen according to observing rules.
comparisons.physical_skill: Rule-based relocation and large-angle orientation.
comparisons.success_condition: Gauge clear by twice obstacle height earns 0.5 and screen door facing north earns 0.5.
comparisons.reason: Environmental-instrument placement is not mechanical calibration.

comparisons.objective: Straighten a training doll’s sprung legs while closing an infantometer footboard.
comparisons.physical_skill: Sustained bimanual limb restraint and measurement-board adjustment.
comparisons.success_condition: Doll straightened, footboard left at the reading, and robot released; numeric reading tolerances are absent.
comparisons.reason: Holding compliant limbs for measurement differs from screw/jam-nut countertorque and retained gripper cycles.

comparisons.objective: Move a slung crate over a hatch coaming using two cargo falls.
comparisons.physical_skill: Differential bimanual rope control and suspended-load positioning.
comparisons.success_condition: Crate clears the coaming, lands on the green pad, hands avoid the load and hatch, then both falls are released.
comparisons.reason: Suspended-load rigging is unrelated to threaded adjustment.

comparisons.objective: Set a three-point bend fixture to a 16:1 span and center a specimen.
comparisons.physical_skill: Fixture-span adjustment and specimen alignment, but the indexed record does not state the adjustment mechanism.
comparisons.success_condition: A 16:1 support span and centered specimen are named; all tolerances, locking requirements, and grading details are absent.
comparisons.reason: This plausibly tests setting and retaining an adjustable industrial fixture, but the missing task body/spec prevents determining whether it uses the same screw-and-locknut counterholding ability.

comparisons.objective: Play three lap-steel notes using a tone bar and plucking hand.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual bar positioning, string plucking, timing, and tool return.
comparisons.success_condition: Three card-specified notes played in order, each ringing for 0.5 second, then bar returned and hands withdrawn.
comparisons.reason: Musical tool coordination is unrelated to mechanical adjustment.

comparisons.objective: Rotate and center a guarded blank using two push tools.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual external tool pushing with guard avoidance and simultaneous pose regulation.
comparisons.success_condition: Blank reaches the marked angle while centered; guard entry zeros the result.
comparisons.reason: Two-tool guarded rotation controls a free blank rather than opposing torque on coupled threaded hardware.

comparisons.objective: Place each girder stop-end within the middle third of its span and clear of the beam.
comparisons.physical_skill: Long-part orientation and placement to geometric zones.
comparisons.success_condition: The title states middle-third and beam-clearance requirements; no body, tolerances, or scoring tiers are indexed.
comparisons.reason: Even with missing rubric detail, long-part placement is clearly different from adjustment-stop locking.

comparisons.objective: Place four named musical notes correctly on a bass-clef staff board.
comparisons.physical_skill: Symbol interpretation and planar token placement.
comparisons.success_condition: D, F, C, and E note heads occupy their correct bass-clef bars; numeric placement tolerance is absent.
comparisons.reason: Symbolic placement does not test mechanical calibration.

comparisons.objective: Spell “hid” in braille using balls in egg-carton cells.
comparisons.physical_skill: Braille reasoning and repeated token placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Each carton encodes the correct unmirrored letter for a reader on the robot side; geometry tolerances are absent.
comparisons.reason: Braille token arrangement is unrelated to threaded adjustment.

comparisons.objective: Prime and operate a siphon by submerging, pinching, and repositioning a hose.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual deformable-hose handling and flow establishment.
comparisons.success_condition: The title specifies a filled hose, pinched outlet carried out, and intake held; no numeric volume or spill rubric is indexed.
comparisons.reason: Deformable fluid-transfer manipulation is meaningfully different from rigid screw-and-locknut calibration.

comparisons.objective: Load washable blender parts into a dishwasher while excluding the motor base.
comparisons.physical_skill: Component classification and rack loading.
comparisons.success_condition: Released stable jug and lid each earn 0.5; motor entry permanently zeros the score.
comparisons.reason: Selective appliance loading does not involve mechanical adjustment.

comparisons.objective: Repository-wide category-name rename, with a telescoping-lamp example spec.
comparisons.physical_skill: The PR is not a task submission; its example involves steadying a lamp base while extending a stem.
comparisons.success_condition: Example lamp reaches at least 6 cm extension with base pose limits; no candidate-like locking step exists.
comparisons.reason: The indexed record is an administrative change and its sole example tests telescoping extension, not screw/jam-nut locking.

comparisons.objective: Select an M4×20 screw from labeled bins and hand it off to a tray.
comparisons.physical_skill: Size-based fastener selection and pick-and-place.
comparisons.success_condition: Exactly one correctly sized screw on the tray within the stated floor-height condition; multiple screws score zero.
comparisons.reason: Selecting a screw by size does not manipulate a threaded adjustment mechanism.

comparisons.objective: Recap a practice syringe using a one-handed scoop technique.
comparisons.physical_skill: Fine cap alignment and insertion while keeping the other hand clear.
comparisons.success_condition: Cap seated on the practice needle, robot released, and prohibited-hand exposure avoided; numeric details are absent.
comparisons.reason: Safety-constrained recapping is an insertion task, not countertorque locking.

comparisons.objective: Pack a cold-chain shipper with a thermal buffer and latch its lid.
comparisons.physical_skill: Ordered packing, separation-layer placement, lid pressing, and spring-latch closure.
comparisons.success_condition: Brick, buffer, and carton correctly separated and lid closed with both latches; incomplete packing or unlatching earns partial credit.
comparisons.reason: Packing and discrete latching do not preserve a continuous mechanical setting.

comparisons.objective: Inspect two plates, serve the intact one, and reject the chipped one.
comparisons.physical_skill: Defect inspection, classification, and careful plate transfer.
comparisons.success_condition: Each correctly sorted stable released plate earns 0.5; wrong sorting or a table drop permanently zeros score.
comparisons.reason: Visual defect sorting is unrelated to adjustment locking.

comparisons.objective: Move the red-tagged vortex mixer to a repair cart.
comparisons.physical_skill: Tag-based equipment selection and upright transfer.
comparisons.success_condition: Tagged unit lifted, upright on tray, working units undisturbed, released and still for 1 second; tip or wrong-unit transfer scores zero.
comparisons.reason: Equipment sorting and transport do not test mechanical calibration.

comparisons.objective: Remove a toy brick obstructing the robot’s own gripper and prove restored motion.
comparisons.physical_skill: Self-recovery manipulation and gripper close-open functional testing.
comparisons.success_condition: Obstruction removed and gripper closing and opening demonstrated; numeric motion thresholds are not in the indexed body.
comparisons.reason: Both finish with functional motion verification, but this tests obstruction removal from the embodiment, not setting and locknut-retaining an angular stop.

comparisons.objective: Build the minimum-piece shim stack reaching a target height.
comparisons.physical_skill: Thickness selection, arithmetic, and flat stacking.
comparisons.success_condition: Top at 80±2 mm using as few shims as possible.
comparisons.reason: Discrete shim stacking is not an adjustable threaded mechanism.

comparisons.objective: Measure concealed travel of several sliders and mark the largest.
comparisons.physical_skill: Actively probing both travel stops and comparing measured ranges.
comparisons.success_condition: Every slider tested at both stops and the largest-range unit identified; numeric scoring details are absent.
comparisons.reason: Travel inspection measures existing ranges rather than setting and locking one against tightening reaction.

comparisons.objective: Move a hand-supported loaded tray to a shelf before withdrawing support.
comparisons.physical_skill: Support transfer while retaining two payloads.
comparisons.success_condition: Tray reaches shelf, tins remain below the tray rim and contained, then supporting hand withdraws.
comparisons.reason: Support transfer and payload retention do not involve adjustment hardware.

comparisons.objective: Slide a hand-supported load onto a shelf beneath an overhanging rail.
comparisons.physical_skill: Constrained support transfer and hand withdrawal.
comparisons.success_condition: Load supported on the shelf and hand safely withdrawn; the body omits numeric rubric details.
comparisons.reason: Restricted-access load transfer differs from screw-and-locknut calibration.

comparisons.objective: Transfer support of a gravity-loaded cover and control its closure.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual support handoff and speed-controlled articulated lowering.
comparisons.success_condition: Cover support transferred, closure speed kept within an observable limit, and supporting hand withdrawn; threshold is absent.
comparisons.reason: Controlled cover lowering tests load transfer, not adjustable-stop locking.

comparisons.objective: Extract a bracket pin while maintaining a weighted carriage’s height.
comparisons.physical_skill: Load support during fastener extraction.
comparisons.success_condition: Pin removed with carriage height maintained and no constraint violation; numeric tolerances are absent.
comparisons.reason: Supporting a load during pin removal is different from applying opposing torques to preserve a threaded setting.

comparisons.objective: Clean a fiber connector end face and plug it into an adapter.
comparisons.physical_skill: Controlled wiping followed by precise connector insertion without contamination.
comparisons.success_condition: At least 4 cm single-stroke wipe, no subsequent unwanted end-face contact, connector fully inserted and released.
comparisons.reason: Cleaning and connector insertion do not test threaded calibration or cyclic retention.

comparisons.objective: Seat parties at tables selected by chair count, unlike adjusting and locking a gripper stop.
comparisons.physical_skill: Count and place reservation markers; no tool seating, countertorque, or mechanical adjustment.
comparisons.success_condition: Both markers must be on the specified tables; no retained setting or actuation test.
comparisons.reason: It tests visual counting and placement, not preservation of a threaded adjustment during locking.

comparisons.objective: Load a press and operate a two-hand control safely, not configure a robot gripper.
comparisons.physical_skill: Blank placement, withdrawal from a hazard, and simultaneous button holding.
comparisons.success_condition: Press closes on the blank while both controls are held after grippers clear the die.
comparisons.reason: Simultaneous safety-control operation is meaningfully different from concentric screw-and-jam-nut adjustment.

comparisons.objective: Vent a tank before draining it, unlike setting and locking an opening stop.
comparisons.physical_skill: Ordered valve operation rather than precision tool engagement and counterholding.
comparisons.success_condition: Vent opens before drain and the tank empties safely.
comparisons.reason: It tests safety ordering, not a mechanically retained adjustment.

comparisons.objective: Distribute plates without overloading a rack, not adjust equipment.
comparisons.physical_skill: Capacity-aware pick-and-place rather than coupled threaded manipulation.
comparisons.success_condition: Three plates on the rack and two in overflow, with no fourth rack plate.
comparisons.reason: Load-limit compliance and placement do not exercise adjustment locking or functional cycling.

comparisons.objective: Place cups at named guests' places, unlike gripper-stop configuration.
comparisons.physical_skill: Read names and place cups; no articulated mechanism or tools.
comparisons.success_condition: Cups occupy Ana's and Sam's places.
comparisons.reason: It tests semantic place assignment, not physical adjustment retention.

comparisons.objective: Choose contrasting cups for resident mats, not set a mechanical stop.

rejected.reason: novelty-critic: The novelty review is otherwise complete: catalog_total=2397, required_total=required_compared=687, with no missing required IDs or duplicate comparison IDs. The only overlap/uncertain records—PR 545 (https://github.com/robocurve/benchmark-tasks/pull/545), PR 963, PR 1361, PR 1742, and PR 1801 (https://github.com/robocurve/benchmark-tasks/pull/1801)—are verified closed, unmerged, other-team, non-board-required archival history and remain correctly labeled rather than being relabeled distinct.; Material repair required: artifacts/selected.json says any “motion outside the modeled 20°–180° range scores 0.” SCHUNK’s catalog describes 20°–180° as the adjustable maximum-opening range, while the DRG 80 technical data gives a 1.5° closed angle per jaw. The current request explicitly permits closing below 20° during functional cycles. Rewrite this failure condition to apply only to the configured maximum-opening setting or true mechanical-limit violations, not ordinary closing motion; propagate the corrected candidate digest into both novelty artifacts.; Industrial grounding is sufficient: SCHUNK manual 389041 v5.00 §5.4.1 specifies installing nuts 73 and 74, setting the opening with the adjusting screw, tightening via nut 73, and testing by actuating the gripper (https://media.distributordatasolutions.com/web_schunk/2023q1/documents/ea9d09a544db3115509a083c4761f6a0e4de75cd.pdf). The DRG 80 catalog supports the adjustable opening, materials, and reference dimensions (https://d16vz4puxlsxm1.cloudfront.net/asset/076200133045-Prod/document_kc3stq0h2h21d7vft0jis2fq30/DRG%2080%20Catalog%20section.pdf).; The six original-suite comparisons are substantively distinct and hash-verified: LIBERO “turn_on_the_stove,” RoboCasa “LowerHeat,” SimplerEnv “OpenDrawerInSceneEnv,” BEHAVIOR “attach_a_camera_to_a_tripod” and “assembling_furniture,” DataCenterBench “DC-knob — Turn the knob to the mark,” and RoboDojo “fasten_screws.” None tests preserving a calibrated screw setting against concentric jam-nut reaction followed by released cyclic retention.; Close active records including PR 1540 sensor-cable counterholding, PR 2018 lever-set installation, PR 2145 cable-gland retention, PR 2167 brake adjustment, PR 1865 hinge adjustment, PR 2203 belt-tension locking, and PR 2229 feeler-gap cam locking have concrete mechanism and outcome comparisons. Their shared adjustment, fastening, or verification primitives do not subsume the candidate’s coupled screw/jam-nut countertorque, provided that causality is physically implemented at the later physics gate.
